statement: The frame prints on the Snapmaker U1 in one sitting, with supports where it needs them
rationale: A kid at the printer: one plate, an afternoon. REVISED 2026-10-17: supports are allowed (R7); the 3D frame is not drawn to the 45 degree rule, so the no-support overhang check no longer judges it. It prints flat, as it flies (print_tilt_deg 0), with tree supports. The frame must fit the 270 mm bed with its brim, every wall must be printable at the U1's 0.4 mm nozzle, and the whole job must fit the 3 h ceiling.

mechanism.how: fdm-print pack: bed fit with brim, minimum wall, print time; the overhang and bridge measurements report how much support the slicer will add
